_doc: CoinGlass yellow-line targets for estimator calibration. alive = lines still present at the capture time (the only ones a capture-time estimate can match). lime = bright yellow-green lines, kept separate (not counted as yellow). group = same-market-day cluster (24h windows overlap) used as the unit for cross-validation. Values were read from pixels with a repeatability of about +-25 USD. 07:50 UTC 10-29 is a duplicate of 06:39 UTC and is excluded.

samples.note: status of each line not recorded in the first reading; all treated as alive (lines lie on both sides of the price 83,840)
78508 is a short right-edge segment (width 26 px, marginal). Added before any tuning run, so it belongs to the tuning set. Its 24h window overlaps group E samples by 13-20h (grouped by UTC day).
Added before any tuning run (tuning set). The 24h window overlaps the 02:54 UTC sample by 17h. Collected data lagged 1h (last bar 08:30 UTC).

First sample whose 24h window does not overlap any earlier sample (new independent group). Added before any tuning run. 78530 is a short right-edge segment (width 62 px). 77139/77017 (x 426-497) are consumed (price dropped through at x~500).
Added after the (not adopted) search; baseline is unchanged -> out-of-sample. Group G overlaps the 11-02 23:49 sample (13h). 77162 is a short left segment (consumed).
Added after mmr=0 freeze -> out-of-sample. New independent group (24h window does not overlap earlier samples).
